records.content: VERIFIED DEAD END (2026-09-12): Perseus native capture is not an activation path. Captured entities land status='proposed', source='capture', requires_review=true, with hash-only provenance, and public readers see none of them: scan total 0, history total 0, get_entity 'Entity not found', and recall abstains (no_match) even with rows stored. Do not propose native capture as a way to get knowledge into recall. It also derives no replacement lineage — conversation 1 and conversation 2 land on different keys with links: [] and no status change on the earlier record, so two production statements coexist undifferentiated. The verified activation path is CLI `write`, which lands status='active', source='cli-write'. Evidence: implementer/repo-glm-dsh2/scripts/experiment_20260912_native_capture/FINDINGS.md (items 1 and 4).

records.content: VERIFIED DEAD END (2026-09-12, reproduced in two independent arms): writing a record through the native `remember` path with the same category+key as an ACTIVE record demotes it. Observed sequence: CLI `write` -> status='active', source='cli-write'; recall serves the record; native `remember` on the same category+key -> status active -> proposed, source='agent'; recall then abstains (no_match). The response reports action:'updated' with ok:true while silently dropping the record out of the serveable set. Reproduced with and without an admission envelope; identical demotion both times. Do not migrate confirmed records from CLI write to native remember. Keep CLI `write` as the activation path. Evidence: team/PROBE-remember-admission-FINDINGS.md (the decisive result, section 4) and receipts 04/10 plus scratch-repro-* arms.

records.content: VERIFIED DEAD END, NARROWED (2026-09-12; row-6 refinement same day): the public admission tool cannot admit a candidate that carries no admission evidence. Approving a bare proposal (the default native-remember and capture output) fails with 'admission_decide candidate has no admission evidence'. That exact class is dead: capture's proposals never embed the evidence block, so admission_decide cannot rescue them. NARROWING (row 6 unit-test receipt, team/PROBE-row6-admission-unit-tests.md): the admitted path itself is NOT inert. When valid evidence is constructed — a journal admission_source event bound to the record digest, workspace, actor and transport-stamped requester, then remember(admission) with source_trust 'authoritative' and validated true — the public tools return admission.outcome 'admitted', disposition 'save', serveable true, stored status 'active'. So the rule is: evidence-free candidate = dead; bind valid evidence first. Do not describe the whole admission chain as unreachable. Evidence: team/PROBE-remember-admission-FINDINGS.md item 3 and receipt 04b; team/PROBE-row6-admission-unit-tests.md section 4 and receipts/11-public-admitted-path.json.
records.do_not: do not expect perseus_vault_admission_decide to rescue a proposal that has no admission evidence; and do not claim the admitted path is unreachable
records.working_alternative: bind a verified admission_source event to the record first, then write/approve; verified 2026-09-12 as outcome 'admitted' / status 'active' / serveable true

records.content: VERIFIED TRAP (2026-09-12): the capability vocabulary is a footgun in three ways. (1) The real nouns are memory.propose, memory.commit, memory.read, memory.admission.review, memory.admission.source. A manifest naming memory.write.propose / memory.write.commit denies every write, and the error echoes the wrong noun back — 'agent probe-operator lacks required capability memory.propose (manifest allows: ...memory.write.propose, memory.write.commit)' — so a vocabulary mistake looks like a permissions problem. (2) perseus_vault_authority_set fails with a bare 'EOF while parsing a value at line 1 column 0' if capability_constraints_json is omitted, because it defaults to the empty string and is fed to serde_json::from_str; pass '{}'. (3) authority_set mode defaults to 'shadow', which silently does NOT satisfy admission requirements; pass mode 'enforce'. Evidence: team/PROBE-remember-admission-FINDINGS.md (sibling finding).
records.do_not: do not name memory.write.propose or memory.write.commit in an authority manifest; do not omit capability_constraints_json; do not rely on the default mode
records.working_alternative: allowed_capabilities use memory.propose/memory.commit/memory.read/memory.admission.*; pass capability_constraints_json '{}' and mode 'enforce'

The only ID-level reader data (Gen124, 17 items) is exploratorily unquotable as a system score. Do not budget row 6 as 'just apply the metric'. Evidence: team/PROBE-row6-data-gap.md.
